description: Annotates an ML/DL Python project in one call (ml_categorize_files, ml_annotate_plan, ml_annotate_project) and rules on the tree with dftracer_annotate_ml_check.
instructions: Fast path: ml_annotate_plan(run_id, threshold=20) to review, ml_annotate_project(run_id, threshold=20) to execute, annotate_add_app_metadata on the entry file, validate_annotations(language='python'), then dftracer_annotate_ml_check(path=<annotated tree>). Use the manual recipe (dftracer_annotate_ai) only for a file the tools got wrong.
